mapper.select:
SELECT
b.guoku_DSCR AS `${column}`
CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN a.QUERY_ITME = '${column}' AND LENGTH('${column}')<>32 THEN a.ITME_VALUE END) > 0 THEN FORMAT(SUM(CASE WHEN a.QUERY_ITME = '${column}' AND LENGTH('${column}')<>32 THEN a.ITME_VALUE END), 0) ELSE 0 END AS `${column}`
FROM `inspection`.`inspection_statistical_table` a LEFT JOIN dmcode.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` b ON a.`ITME_VALUE` = b.`guoku_id` JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_task` c ON a.TASK_ID = c.INSPECTION_TASK_ID WHERE 1=1
AND c.`INSPECTION_PLAN_ID` = #{params.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID}
GROUP BY a.TASK_ID

SELECT a.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID, a.INSPECTION_PLAN_YEAR, a.INSPECTION_PLAN_TYPE, ( SELECT ENUM_DSCR FROM enumset.`cm_guoku_enumeration` b WHERE b.ENUM_TYPE_ID = '12' AND b.ENUM_ID = a.`INSPECTION_PLAN_TYPE` ) AS INSPECTION_PLAN_TYPE_DSCR, a.INSPECTION_PLAN_NAME, a.INSPECTION_PLAN_BEGINTIME, a.INSPECTION_PLAN_ENDTIME, CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(a.INSPECTION_PLAN_BEGINTIME, '%m-%d'), '至', DATE_FORMAT(a.INSPECTION_PLAN_ENDTIME, '%m-%d') ) AS INSPECTION_PLAN_TIME, a.INSPECTION_GUOKU, a.INSPECTION_PLAN_INDEX, a.INSPECTION_PLAN_STATE, a.UPDATE_TIME, a.CHECK_ORG, REPLACE(a.CHECK_ORG_DSCR,'中国人民银行','') AS CHECK_ORG_DSCR, a.CHECKED_ORG, REPLACE(a.CHECKED_ORG_DSCR,'中国人民银行','') AS CHECKED_ORG_DSCR, a.INSPECTION_BOOKORG_ID, a.INSPECTION_BOOKORG_DSCR, a.IS_BUILDTASK, a.BUILDTASK_DATE FROM `inspection`.`inspection_plan` a WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_YEAR = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_YEAR}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_STATE = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_STATE}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_TYPE = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_TYPE}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_NAME like '%${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_NAME}%'
AND a.INSPECTION_GUOKU = '${params.INSPECTION_GUOKU}'
AND b.BOOKORG_ID = #{params.BOOKORG_ID}
AND a.CHECK_ORG = #{params.CHECK_ORG}
AND a.CHECKED_ORG = #{params.CHECKED_ORG}
AND (a.CHECK_ORG_DSCR like '%${params.CHECK_KEY_WORD}%' or a.INSPECTION_GUOKU_DSCR like '%${params.CHECK_KEY_WORD}%')
AND (a.CHECKED_ORG_DSCR like '%${params.CHECKED_KEY_WORD}%' or a.BOOKORG_DSCR like '%${params.CHECKED_KEY_WORD}%' or a.INSPECTED_GUOKU_DSCR like '%${params.CHECKED_KEY_WORD}%')
ORDER BY a.UPDATE_TIME DESC
LIMIT ${params.page},${params.rows}

SELECT COUNT(0) FROM `inspection`.`inspection_plan` a WHERE 1 = 1
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_YEAR = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_YEAR}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_STATE = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_STATE}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_TYPE = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_TYPE}'
AND a.INSPECTION_PLAN_NAME like '%${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_NAME}%'
AND a.INSPECTION_GUOKU = '${params.INSPECTION_GUOKU}'
AND b.BOOKORG_ID = #{params.BOOKORG_ID}
AND a.CHECK_ORG = #{params.CHECK_ORG}
AND a.CHECKED_ORG = #{params.CHECKED_ORG}
AND (a.CHECK_ORG_DSCR like '%${params.CHECK_KEY_WORD}%' or a.INSPECTION_GUOKU_DSCR like '%${params.CHECK_KEY_WORD}%')
AND (a.CHECKED_ORG_DSCR like '%${params.CHECKED_KEY_WORD}%' or a.BOOKORG_DSCR like '%${params.CHECKED_KEY_WORD}%' or a.INSPECTED_GUOKU_DSCR like '%${params.CHECKED_KEY_WORD}%')

SELECT a.`INSPECTION_GROUP_NAME`, a.`INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID`, a.INSPECTION_GROUP_ID, a.INSPECTION_TASK_ID, b.ID, d.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME, d.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME, d.INSPECTION_TASK_STATE, (SELECT DISTINCT guoku_dscr FROM dmcode.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` WHERE guoku_id = a.`INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID`) AS INSPECTED_GUOKU_DSCR, b.INSPECTION_GROUP_USER , c.`NAME` AS INSPECTION_GROUP_USER_NAME, IFNULL(b.`INSPECTION_GROUP_DUTIES`,'3') AS INSPECTION_GROUP_DUTIES, (SELECT ENUM_DSCR FROM `enumset`.`cm_guoku_enumeration` WHERE ENUM_ID=b.`INSPECTION_GROUP_DUTIES` AND ENUM_TYPE_ID='7') AS INSPECTION_GROUP_DUTIES_DSCR , ( SELECT CONCAT(FORMAT(aa.sub_total/aa.total*100,2), '%') AS IS_FINSH FROM ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.`INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_SIGN` = '0' THEN t2.`INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_ID` END) AS sub_total, COUNT(t2.`INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_ID`) AS total, t1.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_process` t1 JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_process_sub` t2 ON t1.`ID` = t2.`PROCESS_ID` WHERE t2.`INSPECTION_PROCESS_SUB_ID` NOT LIKE '___040_' GROUP BY t1.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` ) aa WHERE aa.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = a.INSPECTION_TASK_ID ) AS IS_FINSH, d.BOOKORG_ID, d.BOOKORG_DSCR, e.* FROM `inspection`.`inspection_group` a LEFT JOIN `inspection`.inspection_group_user b ON a.`INSPECTION_GROUP_ID` =b.`INSPECTION_GROUP_ID` LEFT JOIN inspection.`cm_guoku_talentpool` c ON b.`INSPECTION_GROUP_USER`=c.UUID JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_task` d on a.INSPECTION_TASK_ID = d.INSPECTION_TASK_ID JOIN inspection.inspection_plan e on d.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID = e.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID WHERE 1=1
and d.`INSPECTION_PLAN_ID` = '${params.INSPECTION_PLAN_ID}'
and a.INSPECTION_TASK_ID ='${params.INSPECTION_TASK_ID}'
order by INSPECTION_GROUP_NAME

SELECT count(1) FROM inspection.inspection_group_user t JOIN inspection.inspection_group i ON t.INSPECTION_GROUP_ID = i.INSPECTION_GROUP_ID JOIN inspection.inspection_task k ON i.INSPECTION_TASK_ID = k.INSPECTION_TASK_ID WHERE t.INSPECTION_GROUP_USER = '${params.INSPECTION_GROUP_USER}' AND ( ( '${params.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME}' >= k.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME AND '${params.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME}' <= k.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME ) OR ( '${params.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME}' < k.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME AND '${params.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME}' > k.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME ) OR ( '${params.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME}' >= k.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME AND '${params.INSPECTION_TASK_BEGINTIME}' <= k.INSPECTION_TASK_ENDTIME ) )
